Network.Technology: LTE Advanced, 4G+/LTE-A, X12 LTE Cat.12 up to 600 Mbps download speed

Body.Other: MIL-STD810G US Military standard Drop protection, AL6013 body, PolyCarbonate plastic up&down**, Metal battery cover with NFC antenna, rear-mounted Fast Fingerprint sensor, QuickCharge 3.0, USB Power Delivery Rev. 2, Steady Record 2.0, 24bit/192kHz Studio Quality sound recording to in FLAC audio format, Barometer sensor,"Game battery saver" energy saving function

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 7.0 "Nougat", Current: Android 8.0 "Oreo" (international), Android 9.0 "Pie" (F800L/S/K only), Unofficial alternative: Android 10, Android 11, Android 12.1, Android 13, Android 14, Android 15
Platform.CPU: Quad-core (2x2.15 GHz Kryo & 2x1.6 GHz Kryo), HMP (2clusters), MSM8996, ARMv8 64bit architecture, 14 nm

Display.Display: 5.7 in Graphics display resolution#QHD / WQHD (2560×1440), QuadHD 2560×1440 1440p (515 pixel density, ppi) LG Quantum IPS panel, IPS LCD Gorilla Glass, Corning Gorilla Glass 4 Screen Protection, Secondary display 2.1 in 160×1040

Cameras.Rear camera: 16 MP f/1.8 aperture 75° normal angle lens, 8 MP f/2.4 aperture 135° wide angle lens, Image stabilization#Optical image stabilization, OIS,2x Optical zoom, 4K/30fps video recording, Support Google CameraAPI2 manual mode, PDAF(Phase Detection AutoFocus) and Laser AF(LDAF) with Contrast AF, Dual LED flash
Cameras.Front camera: 5 MP f/1.9 aperture,83/120° wide-angle lens, FullHD 1080p video recording

Sound.Sound: Bottom-firing mono speaker, ESS Sabre "32bit Hi-Fi" QuadDAC+Headphones Amplifier

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB-C 1.0 reversible USB2.0 speed, Bluetooth 4.2 with AptX-HD, LE, A2DP, NFC(File sending and Tap&Pay), GLONASS GPS support, IR for LG Remote, Wi-Fi a/b/g/n/ac with dual-band(2.4GHz and 5GHz), FM radio with RDS)
